purpose: Rimegepant is used to treat migraine headaches with or without aura in adults. It can be taken when a migraine starts to relieve pain and other symptoms. It can also be taken every other day to help prevent migraines from happening as often.
how_it_works: During a migraine, your body releases a protein called CGRP that causes pain and inflammation in your head. Rimegepant blocks the receptor that CGRP attaches to, which helps stop the migraine attack. Think of it like putting a lock on a door so the pain signal cannot get through.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is nausea. Some people may also experience stomach pain or an allergic reaction such as trouble breathing, rash, or swelling of the face or throat. Most people tolerate it well.
warnings: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, as this medication may not be safe during pregnancy. Avoid taking it if you have had a serious allergic reaction to rimegepant before. Let your doctor know about all other medications you take, especially antifungal medicines or certain antibiotics, as they can affect how rimegepant works in your body.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one 75 mg orally dissolving tablet (ODT) placed on or under your tongue when a migraine starts — it dissolves without water. For prevention, you take one tablet every other day. Do not take more than one tablet in a 24-hour period.
